text: Magnus the Red tried to save his father. It destroyed everything he loved.
The sorcerer Primarch foresaw that Horus would betray the Emperor.
So he used forbidden sorcery to send the warning straight to Terra.
His spell shattered the wards guarding the Emperor's greatest secret.
The Emperor sent the Space Wolves to bring him in. Horus twisted the order into a death sentence.
The Wolves burned Prospero, his city of light, to the ground.
Magnus faced Leman Russ, and Russ broke him.
As his world died, only one power answered his cry: Tzeentch.
He warned his father of a traitor, and became one.
